description: Draws a random voltage on each clock from a seedable random source, with four outputs carrying four different distributions, a range and offset section and a slew limiter

params.text: While on, the values are drawn over -5V to 5V; while off, over 0-10V
Sets how many uniform draws each value is made from, 1 to 20; at 1 the Min, WB and Tri outputs carry a plain uniform distribution
Sets how many channels the outputs carry, 1 to 16, used only while the clock is monophonic or unpatched
Sets the seed, 0 to 1 across the seed range, cut to four decimal places; at 0 the seed comes from the clock of the computer instead and every reset gives a fresh run
Scales every drawn value before it reaches the outputs, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the jack above it before it is added to the Range knob, 0 to 1
Adds a fixed voltage to every drawn value, -5V to 5V
Attenuates the voltage at the jack above it before it is added to the Ofs knob, 0 to 1
Slews the outputs so they glide to each new value; at 0 the slew is off, and raising it lengthens the glide

inputs.text: The clock that draws a new set of values; a polyphonic cable here draws one value per channel of the cable and sets how many channels the outputs carry
A trigger here reseeds the random source from the Seed knob and draws a value at once, so the same run of values is drawn again
A trigger at Rst writes the voltage here into the Seed knob first, 0-10V mapped onto the knob's 0 to 1, so the seed can be set by cable
Sets the number of draws by voltage in place of the Strength knob, 0-10V mapped onto 1 to 20, one channel per output channel
Modulates the scaling, added to the Range knob at a tenth of a volt per volt through the attenuator below it
Modulates the added voltage, one volt per volt through the attenuator below it

outputs.text: The smallest of the draws, scaled by Range and shifted by Ofs, which crowds the values towards the bottom of the range as Strength is raised
A Weibull distribution with its density set by Strength, scaled by Range and shifted by Ofs
The average of the draws, scaled by Range and shifted by Ofs, which crowds the values towards the middle of the range as Strength is raised and approaches a normal distribution
A plain uniform distribution whatever Strength is set to, scaled by Range and shifted by Ofs

notes: with nothing patched into Clk a new value is drawn every sample, giving noise at audio rate; the values are then bipolar whatever BiP is set to, and Range, Ofs and Slew are passed over
an output with no cable in it is never drawn and never written, so patching one later starts it from whatever the random source has reached

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Seed knob.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads half the Strength knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.4:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
inputs.5:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
